title: General Training Writing — Letter 16
description: Task 1 letter, 16 of 29. Write at least 150 words.

sections.title: Writing — Task 1 (letter)
sections.instructions: Write the letter in the box below. It is not auto-scored.

questions.prompt:
Your car is hired from a company and while you are driving on holiday, you have a small accident. You will have to write a report to the company to explain it.
In your letter:
when and where you hired it
describe how the accident happened
what kind of action did you take after the accident
